primary.poolable_reason: k=1. THE PAGE SEEDS exactly one registration. A single trial is reported as a single trial and a topic with none has nothing to report; either way no pool is possible and none is displayed. AUTHORITY: Cochrane Handbook 6.5 (2024) section 10.10.3 -- 'A systematic review need not contain any meta-analyses.' A topic that ends in a sourced non-poolable verdict is a complete review, not a failed one. THE RESIDUE EXCLUSION WAS MADE CONDITIONAL BEFORE THIS COUNT WAS TAKEN. Four identifiers appear across many unrelated pages as build contamination, and a global denylist wrongly reported three heart-failure pages as seeding nothing when each seeds PARADIGM-HF, which on those pages is the genuine trial. A residue id is now KEPT when the topic's own subject appears in that trial's registered title or interventions, and development codes are matched as well as generic names.

primary.what_this_verdict_does_not_establish: NOT that the seeded trial is poor. NOT that the drug is ineffective. NOT that no second trial exists in the world -- only that this page seeds one, and a page cannot pool trials it does not carry. If a second eligible trial is identified, this verdict should be revisited.
primary.poolable_DEPRECATED_note: `poolable` MEANT ONLY 'the source page pooled these trials'. It was never a judgement that the pool was sound, and the renderer read it as permission to assert 'pooled on the X scale'. RENAMED to source_page_pooled, which is what it says. `poolable` is retained so nothing breaks, and it is DEPRECATED: read source_page_pooled for what the source did, and estimand_established for whether the pool is defensible. A PAGE SHOULD DISPLAY A POOLED ESTIMATE BECAUSE ITS ESTIMAND WAS ESTABLISHED, NOT BECAUSE SOMEONE ONCE POOLED IT.
primary.estimand_established_means: TRUE only where every contributing trial has been READ and shown to measure the same quantity, or the same construct with a variance stated. FALSE where that was checked and failed. NULL where it was never checked -- AN ABSENT ASSERTION AND A NEGATIVE ONE ARE DIFFERENT STATES and null is not a pass.

generator_schema_patch_2026_08_18.genuinely_empty: GENUINELY EMPTY for this topic, not emptied to pass a check. The same field is empty on acs-antiplatelet-review, which builds.
generator_schema_patch_2026_08_18.rule: Every field added falls into RELOCATION, GENUINELY EMPTY, or DERIVED FROM RECORDED CONTENT. A field falling into none was REFUSED. Adding a key to satisfy a generator is not the same as adding the content that key should hold.

THE_OBJECT_AS_IT_STOOD_AT_RETIREMENT.all_ranks_captured_2026_08_18: Registered outcomes captured at EVERY rank -- primary, secondary and other -- by re-reading each registration on 2026-08-18. Previously only primaries were recorded, which made this topic's withdrawal UNTESTABLE for proportionality: the SGLT2 failure lived one rank down and we had not kept one rank down. The read date is stamped FOR THIS READ, not carried over.

bookkeeping_2026_08_21._what: The five reporting claims a PRISMA-2020 manuscript needs that are FETCHABLE rather than argued -- each derived from a field here, or stated as an honest absence.
bookkeeping_2026_08_21.which_limbs_this_review_refuses: Of the four properties this project requires of a completed topic, 0 are held (none) and 4 are refused with the obstacle named in the evidence (comparison denominator, grade per pool, model output verbatim, rob per result).
bookkeeping_2026_08_21.whether_this_review_was_prospectively_re: NO PROSPERO REGISTRATION OR PROTOCOL RECORD IS HELD ON THIS OBJECT. That is not the same as knowing this review was not registered, and neither claim is made. It is recorded here as an absence so that a reader does not have to infer it from silence.
bookkeeping_2026_08_21.that_two_assessors_disagreed_and_where: NO SECOND, INDEPENDENT RISK-OF-BIAS ASSESSMENT IS RECORDED FOR THIS TOPIC. The judgements were made once. Stated so that single assessment is not mistaken for agreement between two.
